title: Nouveaux Contes à Ninon
summary: "Nouveaux Contes à Ninon" by Émile Zola is a collection of short stories published in 1874. The stories range from romantic encounters in moonlit gardens to satirical portraits of Second Empire society, student rebellions, and philosophical reflections on work and freedom.
